<script>(function(){var TABLE=document.getElementById('poet-table');if(!TABLE)return;var SEARCH=document.getElementById('poet-search');var INFO=document.getElementById('poet-info');var PAG=document.getElementById('poet-pagination');var SIZE=document.getElementById('poet-page-size');var tbody=TABLE.tBodies[0];var rows=Array.prototype.slice.call(tbody.rows);var ths=Array.prototype.slice.call(TABLE.tHead.rows[0].cells);var pageSize=10;var page=1;var sortKey=-1,sortDir=1;function fold(s){return s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();}function applyFilter(){var q=SEARCH?fold(SEARCH.value):'';if(q){var f=[];for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){if(rows[i].getAttribute('data-search').indexOf(q)!==-1)f.push(rows[i]);}return f;}return rows.slice();}function current(f){var s=f.slice();if(sortKey>=0){var k=sortKey,d=sortDir;s.sort(function(a,b){var av=a.cells[k].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();var bv=b.cells[k].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();if(av<bv)return-d;if(av>bv)return d;return 0;});}return s;}function pageList(cur,total){var out=[];var prev=0;for(var i=1;i<=total;i++){if(i===1||i===2||i===cur-1||i===cur||i===cur+1||i===total-1||i===total){if(i-prev>1)out.push('...');out.push(i);prev=i;}}return out;}function render(){var f=applyFilter();var s=current(f);var total=s.length;var pages=pageSize<0?1:Math.max(1,Math.ceil(total/pageSize));if(page>pages)page=pages;if(page<1)page=1;var start=pageSize<0?0:(page-1)*pageSize;var end=pageSize<0?total:Math.min(start+pageSize,total);for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++)rows[i].style.display='none';for(var j=start;j<end;j++)s[j].style.display='';if(INFO)INFO.textContent='Showing '+(total?(start+1)+'-'+end+' of '+total:'0 of 0')+' entries';renderPager(pages);updateArrows();}function renderPager(pages){if(!PAG)return;var h='<nav><ul class="pagination pagination-sm justify-content-center mb-0">';h+='<li class="page-item'+(page<=1?' disabled':'')+'"><a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="'+(page-1)+'">&laquo;</a></li>';var pl=pageList(page,pages);for(var i=0;i<pl.length;i++){if(pl[i]==='...'){h+='<li class="page-item disabled"><span class="page-link">&hellip;</span></li>';continue;}h+='<li class="page-item'+(pl[i]===page?' active':'')+'"><a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="'+pl[i]+'">'+pl[i]+'</a></li>';}h+='<li class="page-item'+(page>=pages?' disabled':'')+'"><a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="'+(page+1)+'">&raquo;</a></li>';h+='</ul></nav>';PAG.innerHTML=h;var links=PAG.querySelectorAll('a[data-page]');for(var j=0;j<links.length;j++){(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();var p=parseInt(a.getAttribute('data-page'),10);if(!isNaN(p)&&p>=1&&p<=pages){page=p;render();}});})(links[j]);}}function updateArrows(){for(var i=0;i<ths.length;i++){var t=ths[i].querySelector('.sort-indicator');if(!t)continue;t.textContent=(i===sortKey)?(sortDir===1?' \u2191':' \u2193'):'';}}for(var h=0;h<ths.length;h++){(function(th,idx){if(!th.hasAttribute('data-sort'))return;th.style.cursor='pointer';th.addEventListener('click',function(){if(sortKey===idx){sortDir=-sortDir;}else{sortKey=idx;sortDir=1;}page=1;render();});})(ths[h],h);}if(SEARCH)SEARCH.addEventListener('input',function(){page=1;render();});if(SIZE)SIZE.addEventListener('change',function(){pageSize=parseInt(SIZE.value,10);page=1;render();});render();})();</script>
